title: 5-Veg Onion Bhaji Crust Quiche
description: A crustless-pastry quiche with a spiced quinoa and onion 'bhaji' base, filled with an egg custard of roasted red pepper, spinach, peas and carrot.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin seeds (plus more to serve)
1 roasted red pepper in brine, drained and finely chopped
handful of coriander leaves, to serve
steps: Tip quinoa into a small saucepan; cover with cold water; bring to boil. Add onions; simmer gently 12 minutes until water absorbed. Spoon into a mixing bowl; cool 10 minutes.
Add carrot; stir in turmeric, garam masala, cumin seeds and chilli powder; season. Separate one egg; stir egg white through quinoa mixture.
Spray a 24cm tart tin (solid base) with cooking spray; add quinoa mixture; pat down to cover base and sides evenly. Spray again; bake on top shelf for 20 minutes until golden.
Beat 4 remaining eggs plus reserved yolk; add milk; stir in red pepper, spinach and peas; season.
Reduce oven to 180°C/160°C fan. Pour egg mixture into crust; bake 25 minutes.
Serve warm or cold, scattered with cumin seeds and coriander.
notes: Make spicy falafel by adding ½ tsp chilli powder. Keep in fridge up to 5 days or freeze.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
